classification.difficultyReason: Explain the relationship between the survey design and the population using the preceding teaching.

content.prompt: A school surveys every Year 8 student. First it wants information about Year 8 students; later it wants information about all students in the school, which includes other year groups. Identify the population and classify the survey in each case. Explain why the classification changes.

answer.short: Year 8 population: census. All school students: sample. The surveyed group stays fixed, but covers all of the first population and only part of the second.
answer.worked:
First, the population is all Year 8 students. Every member is surveyed, so this is a census.

Later, the population is all students at the school. Only the Year 8 students are surveyed, so this is a sample. The surveyed group has not changed; its coverage relative to the population has changed.
